sources.title: Extra-P automated performance modeling
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: VTune：呼叫樹獨佔時間與CPU時間分母
related.titleEn: VTune: exclusive call-tree time and CPU-time denominators
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告保留原失敗及新驗證計畫，不宣稱Extra-P或任何擬合工具自動保證生產效能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report retains the original failure and a fresh validation plan, without claiming that a modeling tool guarantees production performance.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「VTune：呼叫樹獨佔時間與CPU時間分母」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩版呼叫樹帳本、葉節點守恆、self占比與wall對照；標記無法歸屬的樣本，而非分攤到看起來最忙的函式。
related.differenceEn: Investigate VTune: exclusive call-tree time and CPU-time denominators using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver both call-tree ledgers, leaf-level conservation checks, self percentages and wall-time comparisons. Keep unattributed observations visible instead of assigning them to whichever function appears busiest.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在n=8逐列計算2、4、6秒，再於n=16計算2、8、16秒；將log2的輸入標為無因次，避免對帶秒的量直接取對數。
將children50ms拆成20與30ms，其他工作40ms；與父self30ms合計120ms，再核對父inclusive80ms及25%自身占比。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Build a worksheet showing contributions 2, 4 and 6 seconds at n=8 and 2, 8 and 16 at n=16. Explicitly mark the logarithm argument as dimensionless rather than taking a logarithm of a dimensional duration.

Split child cost into twenty and thirty milliseconds and assign forty milliseconds to other work. Add those leaf costs to thirty milliseconds of parent self time, then reconcile the 120 ms CPU total, 80 ms parent inclusive time and self percentage.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LUMI-G：不能依序號推論 NUMA 的排列成本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告保留原失敗及新驗證計畫，不宣稱Extra-P或任何擬合工具自動保證生產效能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report retains the original failure and a fresh validation plan, without claiming that a modeling tool guarantees production performance.
related.difference: 產生 mapping.csv、assignment.csv、costs.csv；要求裝置鍵唯一，每個配置必須引用存在的 NUMA 節點。
related.differenceEn: Create mapping.csv, assignment.csv and costs.csv. Enforce unique device keys and existing NUMA references, then materialize a joined row for every transfer before performing arithmetic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在n=8逐列計算2、4、6秒，再於n=16計算2、8、16秒；將log2的輸入標為無因次，避免對帶秒的量直接取對數。
把裝置到 NUMA 的映射視為查表函數，再對每條等量傳輸累加教學成本；成本單位是模型權重而非量測奈秒；八條傳輸，局部成本 2、遠端成本 9；名義全為局部，變更為六條局部與二條遠端；名義式 8*2 = 16 cost units；變更式 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Build a worksheet showing contributions 2, 4 and 6 seconds at n=8 and 2, 8 and 16 at n=16. Explicitly mark the logarithm argument as dimensionless rather than taking a logarithm of a dimensional duration.

Treat device-to-NUMA placement as an explicit lookup, then sum the assigned costs of equal-sized transfers. Model cost units are pedagogical weights, not measured nanoseconds or a linear performance prediction. Supply a nonidentity permutation for eight devices. Local transfers cost 2 units and remote transfers cost 9. All eight are local initially; after changing two bindings, six remain local and two become remote. Nominal 8*2 = 16 cost units; changed 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
